## Configuration and Setup

```{r configuration}
config <- list(
  filtering = list(
    abs_filt_samples = 2,
    min_count_threshold = 10
  ),
  statistical = list(
    padj_cutoff = 0.05,
    log2FC_cutoff = 0.37,
    var_expl_needed = 0.6
  ),
  visualization = list(
    ntop_genes_pca = 1000,
    plot_width = 20,
    plot_height = 20,
    plot_units = "cm",
    top_pathways_show = 20
  ),
  biomart = list(
    host = "http://www.ensembl.org",
    dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl",
    version = "Ensembl Genes 109"
```

```{r declare_functions}

# Enhanced fGSEA function 
plot_fGSEA <- function(deg_results, gene_set_list, title_prefix, save_dir, maxSize = 500, figure_extention = ".png"){
  de_genes_ranked <- deg_results
  de_genes_ranked <- de_genes_ranked %>%
    group_by(gene_symbol) %>%
    slice_max(baseMean, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup()
  de_genes_ranked <- de_genes_ranked %>% arrange(desc(log2FoldChange))
  de_genes_ranked <- setNames(c(de_genes_ranked$log2FoldChange), c(de_genes_ranked$gene_symbol))
  de_genes_ranked <- de_genes_ranked[!is.na(names(de_genes_ranked))]

  fgseaRes <- fgsea(
    pathways = gene_set_list,
    stats = de_genes_ranked,
    minSize = 15,
    maxSize = maxSize
  )
   
  for(gene_set_to_plot_name in names(gene_set_list)){
    # gene_set_to_plot_name <- "Cordenonsi_Yap_Conserved_Signature"
    gene_set_to_plot <- gene_set_list[[gene_set_to_plot_name]]
    
    title_values <- fgseaRes %>% filter(pathway == gene_set_to_plot_name) %>% select(pathway, NES, padj)
    p <- plotEnrichment(pathway = gene_set_to_plot, 
                        stats = de_genes_ranked) + 
      labs(title = paste(title_prefix, "\n",
                         title_values$pathway, "\n",
                         "NES =", title_values$NES,
                         "padj = ", title_values$padj))
    plot(p)
    ggsave(file.path(save_dir, paste0(title_prefix, "_", title_values$pathway, figure_extention)), plot = p)
  }
  
}

produce_GSEA_plots <- function(gene_signature, dds_object, additional_title, path_to_pdf_report){
  C5_GOBP <- hypeR::hypeR(
    signature = gene_signature,
    genesets = gs_C5_GOBP,
    test = "hypergeometric",
    background = nrow(dds_object)
  )
  C5_GOCC <- hypeR::hypeR(
    signature = gene_signature,
    genesets = gs_C5_GOCC,
    test = "hypergeometric",
    background = nrow(dds_object)
  )
  C5_GOMF <- hypeR::hypeR(
    signature = gene_signature,
    genesets = gs_C5_GOMF,
    test = "hypergeometric",
    background = nrow(dds_object)
  )
  C2_kegg <- hypeR::hypeR(
    signature = gene_signature,
    genesets = gs_C2_kegg,
    test = "hypergeometric",
    background = nrow(dds_object)
  )
  C2_reactome <- hypeR::hypeR(
    signature = gene_signature,
    genesets = gs_C2_reactome,
    test = "hypergeometric",
    background = nrow(dds_object)
  )
  C6_onco <- hypeR::hypeR(
    signature = gene_signature,
    genesets = gs_C6_onco,
    test = "hypergeometric",
    background = nrow(dds_object)
  )
  wang_hippo <- hypeR::hypeR(
    signature = gene_signature,
    genesets = gs_wang_hippo,
    test = "hypergeometric",
    background = nrow(dds_object)
  )
  
  C5_GOBP_plot <- hypeR::hyp_dots(C5_GOBP, merge = TRUE, fdr = 0.05, top = 20, abrv = 70, val = "fdr", title = paste0("GOBP: ", additional_title)) + theme_bw()
  C5_GOCC_plot <- hypeR::hyp_dots(C5_GOCC, merge = TRUE, fdr = 0.05, top = 20, abrv = 70, val = "fdr", title = paste0("GOCC: ", additional_title))+ theme_bw()
  C5_GOMF_plot <- hypeR::hyp_dots(C5_GOMF, merge = TRUE, fdr = 0.05, top = 20, abrv = 70, val = "fdr", title = paste0("GOMF: ", additional_title)) + theme_bw()
  C2_kegg_plot <- hypeR::hyp_dots(C2_kegg, merge = TRUE, fdr = 0.05, top = 20, abrv = 70, val = "fdr", title = paste0("KEGG: ", additional_title)) + theme_bw()
  C2_rctm_plot <- hypeR::hyp_dots(C2_reactome, merge = TRUE, fdr = 0.05, top = 20, abrv = 70, val = "fdr", title = paste0("REACTOME: ", additional_title)) + theme_bw()
  C6_onco_plot <- hypeR::hyp_dots(C6_onco, merge = TRUE, fdr = 0.05, top = 20, abrv = 70, val = "fdr", title = paste0("ONCO: ", additional_title)) + theme_bw()
  
  pdf(file = file.path(path_to_pdf_report, paste0(additional_title, ".pdf")))
  print(C5_GOBP_plot)
  print(C5_GOCC_plot)
  print(C5_GOMF_plot)
  print(C2_kegg_plot)
  print(C2_rctm_plot)
  print(C6_onco_plot)
  dev.off()
  
  print(C5_GOBP_plot)
  print(C5_GOCC_plot)
  print(C5_GOMF_plot)
  print(C2_kegg_plot)
  print(C2_rctm_plot)
  print(C6_onco_plot)
}
```

```{r generate PCA plot, include=FALSE}
#generate PCA plots
pca_deg <- generatePCA_repel(transf_object = vsd, 
                             cond_interest_varPart = c("cell_line", "time"), 
                             color_variable = "time", 
                             shape_variable = "cell_line",
                             ntop_genes = 1000) +
  ggtitle("Original dataset") 


# Batch correction
transf_batch_NObatch_experiment <- vsd
transf_batch_NObatch_experiment_count <- limma::removeBatchEffect(SummarizedExperiment::assay(transf_batch_NObatch_experiment),
                                                                  transf_batch_NObatch_experiment$batch)
SummarizedExperiment::assay(transf_batch_NObatch_experiment) <- transf_batch_NObatch_experiment_count
pca_deg_NObatch_experiment <- generatePCA_repel(transf_object = transf_batch_NObatch_experiment, 
                                                cond_interest_varPart = c("cell_line","time"), 
                                                color_variable = "time", 
                                                shape_variable = "cell_line",
                                                ntop_genes = 1000) +
  ggtitle("Original dataset - YAP1/TAZ1 inhibition; cell_line batch correction")
```

```{r GSVA on all samples, include=FALSE}
### GSVA to show a shift from MES to ADR identity for all samples ####
# prepare vsd
vsd_counts_matrix <- assay(vsd)
gene_symbols <- annotationData[, 'gene_symbol'][match(row.names(vsd_counts_matrix),
                                                       annotationData[, 'ensembl_id'])]
# Drop genes without a mapped symbol
keep <- !is.na(gene_symbols) & gene_symbols != ""
vsd_counts_matrix <- vsd_counts_matrix[keep, ]
gene_symbols <- gene_symbols[keep]

# Collapse duplicate symbols: keep the row with the highest mean expression
row_means <- rowMeans(vsd_counts_matrix)
keep_idx <- order(row_means, decreasing = TRUE)
keep_idx <- keep_idx[!duplicated(gene_symbols[keep_idx])]
vsd_counts_matrix <- vsd_counts_matrix[keep_idx, ]
row.names(vsd_counts_matrix) <- gene_symbols[keep_idx]

vsd_counts_matrix <- as.matrix(vsd_counts_matrix)
stopifnot(!any(duplicated(rownames(vsd_counts_matrix))))


# Plot terms based on terms defined from RNA-seq profiles obtained from our RNA seq
our_data_param <- GSVA::ssgseaParam(vsd_counts_matrix,
                                    sig_list_our_data,
                                    minSize = 1, maxSize = Inf,
                                    normalize = TRUE)
ssgsea_mes_adr_cellines <- GSVA::gsva(our_data_param,
                                      verbose = TRUE,
                                      BPPARAM = BiocParallel::MulticoreParam(2))

# Replicate groups to average (CM_48h has only 2 replicates)
replicate_groups <- list(
  CM_24h     = c("CM_24h_batch1",     "CM_24h_rep1_1",       "CM_24h_rep2_1",       "CM_24h_rep3"),
  CM_48h     = c("CM_48h_batch1",     "CM_48h_rep1_1",       "CM_48h_rep3"),
  CM_control = c("CM_control_batch1", "CM_DMSO_ctrl_rep1_1", "CM_DMSO_ctrl_rep2_1", "CM_DMSO_ctrl_rep3"),
  SH_24h     = c("SH_24h_batch1",     "SH_24h_rep1_1",       "SH_24h_rep2_1"),
  SH_48h     = c("SH_48h_batch1",     "SH_48h_rep1_1",       "SH_48h_rep2_1"),
  SH_control = c("SH_control_batch1", "SH_DMSO_ctrl_rep1_1", "SH_DMSO_ctrl_rep2_1")
)

# Collapse a ssGSEA score matrix to per-group means (rows = terms, cols = groups)
average_replicates <- function(mat, groups) {
  avg <- vapply(groups, function(cols) {
    cols <- intersect(cols, colnames(mat))
    rowMeans(mat[, cols, drop = FALSE])
  }, FUN.VALUE = numeric(nrow(mat)))
  rownames(avg) <- rownames(mat)
  as.matrix(avg)
}
```

```{r ssgsea_heatmap_by_cell_line}
# The two cell lines (CLBMa / SK_N_SH) differ strongly in overall ssGSEA level, so a
# single row-scaled heatmap is dominated by the cell-line effect rather than the
# MES/ADR contrast. Split the samples by cell line and z-score WITHIN each cell line
# so the biology is visible.

# Column annotation (cell type / treatment / time) pulled from the dds colData,
# aligned to the ssGSEA matrix column order.
col_annot <- as.data.frame(
  colData(k975dds)[colnames(ssgsea_mes_adr_cellines),
                   c("cell_line", "treatment", "time")]
)

# Cell-line membership from the colData, aligned to the ssGSEA matrix column order.
sample_cell_line <- as.character(col_annot$cell_line)

# Build one heatmap per cell line (silent = TRUE so we control drawing/saving).
cell_line_heatmaps <- lapply(sort(unique(sample_cell_line)), function(cl) {
  mat_cl <- ssgsea_mes_adr_cellines[, sample_cell_line == cl, drop = FALSE]
  pheatmap::pheatmap(
    mat_cl,
    scale = "row",              # z-score within this cell line only
    annotation_col = col_annot,
    cluster_rows = TRUE,
    cluster_cols = TRUE,
    color = colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "firebrick3"))(50),
    show_colnames = TRUE,
    main = paste0("MES/ADR ssGSEA — ", cl),
    silent = TRUE
  )
})
names(cell_line_heatmaps) <- sort(unique(sample_cell_line))

# Draw each heatmap into the knitted document.
for (cl in names(cell_line_heatmaps)) {
  grid::grid.newpage()
  grid::grid.draw(cell_line_heatmaps[[cl]]$gtable)
}

# Save each heatmap to its own PDF.
for (cl in names(cell_line_heatmaps)) {
  pdf(file.path(PATHS$results_dir, paste0("ssgsea_mes_adr_heatmap_", cl, ".pdf")),
      width = 8, height = 5)
  grid::grid.draw(cell_line_heatmaps[[cl]]$gtable)
  dev.off()
}
```

```{r ssgsea_dynamics_prep}
# Instead of absolute ssGSEA levels (which carry a per-batch / per-cell-line
# baseline), look at the DYNAMIC: the change over the DMSO -> 24h -> 48h course.
# Referencing each series to its own DMSO baseline cancels that baseline offset,
# so CM and SH (and the two batches) become directly comparable.

adr_name <- grep("^Ader", rownames(ssgsea_mes_adr_cellines), value = TRUE)  # "Aderenergic"
mes_name <- grep("^Mes",  rownames(ssgsea_mes_adr_cellines), value = TRUE)  # "Mesenchymal"

# One row per sample, with its two signature scores and its metadata.
score_long <- data.frame(
  sample = colnames(ssgsea_mes_adr_cellines),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
score_long$ADR <- ssgsea_mes_adr_cellines[adr_name, score_long$sample]
score_long$MES <- ssgsea_mes_adr_cellines[mes_name, score_long$sample]

# Cell line (CM / SH) and series group (batch1 / rep1 / rep2) from the sample name.
score_long$cell  <- sub("^(CM|SH)_.*", "\\1", score_long$sample)
score_long$group <- ifelse(grepl("_batch1$", score_long$sample),
                           "batch1",
                           stringr::str_extract(score_long$sample, "rep[0-9]"))
# A "series" is one time course: e.g. CM_batch1, CM_rep1, SH_rep2, ...
score_long$series <- paste(score_long$cell, score_long$group, sep = "_")

# Time as an ordered factor DMSO < 24h < 48h (from the dds colData).
score_long$time <- factor(
  as.character(colData(k975dds)[score_long$sample, "time"]),
  levels = c("DMSO", "h24", "h48"),
  labels = c("DMSO", "24h", "48h")
)

# Long over signature, then Delta = score - (that series' DMSO score).
score_long <- score_long %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c(ADR, MES),
                      names_to = "signature", values_to = "score") %>%
  group_by(series, signature) %>%
  mutate(baseline = score[time == "DMSO"][1],
         delta    = score - baseline) %>%
  ungroup()

print(score_long)
```

```{r ssgsea_dynamics_trajectory}
# (1) Trajectory line plots: Delta-from-DMSO vs time, one line per series,
#     faceted into MES and ADR panels.
p_traj <- ggplot(score_long,
                 aes(x = time, y = delta,
                     group = series, colour = cell, linetype = group)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ signature) +
  labs(title    = "MES / ADR ssGSEA dynamics (Δ from DMSO)",
       subtitle = "Each series referenced to its own DMSO baseline",
       x = "Time", y = "Δ ssGSEA score (vs DMSO)",
       colour = "Cell line", linetype = "Series") +
  theme_bw()

print(p_traj)
ggsave(file.path(PATHS$results_dir, "ssgsea_mes_adr_trajectory_delta.pdf"),
       p_traj, width = 22, height = 12, units = "cm")
```

```{r ssgsea_dynamics_delta_heatmap}
# (2) Delta-from-DMSO heatmap: rows = signature, columns = series x timepoint
#     (24h, 48h only; DMSO is the reference so its delta is 0).
delta_hm_df <- score_long %>%
  filter( !is.na(delta)) %>%
  mutate(col_id = paste(series, time, sep = "_"))

delta_wide <- tidyr::pivot_wider(delta_hm_df[, c("signature", "col_id", "delta")],
                                 names_from = col_id, values_from = delta)
delta_mat <- as.matrix(delta_wide[, -1])
rownames(delta_mat) <- delta_wide$signature

# Column annotation + a stable ordering (by cell, then series group, then time).
col_annot_delta <- delta_hm_df %>% distinct(col_id, cell, group, time)
col_annot_delta <- data.frame(
  cell  = col_annot_delta$cell,
  group = col_annot_delta$group,
  time  = col_annot_delta$time,
  row.names = col_annot_delta$col_id
)
ord <- rownames(col_annot_delta)[order(col_annot_delta$cell,
                                       col_annot_delta$group,
                                       col_annot_delta$time)]
delta_mat <- delta_mat[, ord, drop = FALSE]

# Diverging colour scale centred on 0 (no row scaling: values are already deltas).
max_abs <- max(abs(delta_mat), na.rm = TRUE)
delta_breaks <- seq(-max_abs, max_abs, length.out = 51)

delta_mat <- as.data.frame(delta_mat)
delta_mat <-  delta_mat["MES",
                        c(
  "CM_batch1_DMSO",
  "CM_rep2_DMSO",
  "CM_rep1_DMSO",
  "CM_rep3_DMSO",
  "SH_batch1_DMSO",
  "SH_rep1_DMSO",
  "SH_rep2_DMSO",
  "CM_batch1_24h",
  "CM_rep1_24h",
  "CM_rep2_24h",
  "CM_rep3_24h",
  "SH_batch1_24h",
  "SH_rep1_24h",
  "SH_rep2_24h",
  "CM_batch1_48h",
  "CM_rep1_48h",
  "CM_rep3_48h",
  "SH_batch1_48h",
  "SH_rep1_48h",
  "SH_rep2_48h"
                                                             )]
delta_heatmap <- pheatmap::pheatmap(
  delta_mat,
  scale = "none",
  color = colorRampPalette(c(
    "navy",
     "white",
    "firebrick3"
    ))(50),
#  breaks = delta_breaks,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  annotation_col = col_annot_delta,
  main = "Δ ssGSEA from DMSO (24h, 48h)",
  show_colnames = TRUE,
  silent = TRUE
)
grid::grid.newpage(); grid::grid.draw(delta_heatmap$gtable)

pdf(file.path(PATHS$results_dir, "ssgsea_mes_adr_delta_heatmap.pdf"),
    width = 8, height = 4)
delta_heatmap
dev.off()
```

```{r target_gene_boxplots}
# Boxplots of normalized (batch-corrected VST) expression for the YAP/TAZ and AP-1
# target genes, comparing DMSO -> 24h -> 48h within each cell line separately.
#
# Statistics come from DESeq2 (negative-binomial GLM), NOT a t-test on the VST values.
# The existing deg_results (design ~ cell_line + time) gives the time effect POOLED
# across both cell lines and has no 24h-vs-48h contrast, so it cannot annotate per-cell-
# line panels. We therefore refit with a combined cell_line x time factor and extract the
# six within-cell-line pairwise contrasts. The boxplots still SHOW the batch-corrected VST
# values (for display); the p-values come from the count model.

genes_boxplot <- c("YAP1", "WWTR1", "JUN", "FOSL1", "FOSL2", "CCN2", "ANKRD1", "NOTCH1", "NOTCH2", "MAML2")

# Map gene symbols to the ensembl ids used as rownames of the expression matrix.
gene_ids <- annotationData$ensembl_id[match(genes_boxplot, annotationData$gene_symbol)]
names(gene_ids) <- genes_boxplot
stopifnot(!any(is.na(gene_ids)))

# --- Display values: batch-corrected VST (same matrix used for the heatmaps) ----------
expr_mat <- SummarizedExperiment::assay(transf_batch_NObatch_experiment)

meta <- as.data.frame(colData(k975dds)[, c("cell_line", "time")])
meta$sample <- rownames(meta)

expr_long <- lapply(genes_boxplot, function(g) {
  data.frame(
    sample = colnames(expr_mat),
    gene   = g,
    expr   = expr_mat[gene_ids[[g]], ],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}) %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows() %>%
  dplyr::left_join(meta, by = "sample")

expr_long$time <- factor(expr_long$time,
                         levels = c("DMSO", "h24", "h48"),
                         labels = c("DMSO", "24h", "48h"))
expr_long$gene <- factor(expr_long$gene, levels = genes_boxplot)

# --- Stats: refit DESeq2 with a combined cell_line x time factor ----------------------
dds_group <- k975dds
dds_group$group <- factor(paste(dds_group$cell_line, dds_group$time, sep = "_"))
design(dds_group) <- ~ batch + group   # keep batch control; group carries cell_line & time
dds_group <- DESeq2::DESeq(dds_group)

# padj for our genes for one within-cell-line contrast (numerator vs denominator group).
get_padj <- function(num, den) {
  res <- DESeq2::results(dds_group, contrast = c("group", num, den))
  as.numeric(res[gene_ids, "padj"])   # ordered as genes_boxplot
}

# The six within-cell-line pairwise comparisons.
stat_spec <- data.frame(
  cell_line = c("CLBMa", "CLBMa", "CLBMa", "SK_N_SH", "SK_N_SH", "SK_N_SH"),
  group1    = c("DMSO",  "DMSO",  "24h",   "DMSO",    "DMSO",    "24h"),
  group2    = c("24h",   "48h",   "48h",   "24h",     "48h",     "48h"),
  num       = c("CLBMa_h24", "CLBMa_h48", "CLBMa_h48",
                "SK_N_SH_h24", "SK_N_SH_h48", "SK_N_SH_h48"),
  den       = c("CLBMa_DMSO", "CLBMa_DMSO", "CLBMa_h24",
                "SK_N_SH_DMSO", "SK_N_SH_DMSO", "SK_N_SH_h24"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

stat_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(stat_spec)), function(i) {
  s <- stat_spec[i, ]
  data.frame(
    cell_line = s$cell_line,
    gene      = genes_boxplot,
    group1    = s$group1,
    group2    = s$group2,
    padj      = get_padj(s$num, s$den),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))

# Stagger bracket heights per (cell_line, gene) using each panel's own y-range.
y_ranges <- expr_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(cell_line, gene) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(ymax = max(expr), step = (max(expr) - min(expr)) * 0.14,
                   .groups = "drop")

stat_df <- stat_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(cell_line, gene) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(rank = dplyr::row_number()) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::left_join(y_ranges, by = c("cell_line", "gene")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    y.position = ymax + step * rank,
    gene       = factor(gene, levels = genes_boxplot),
    label      = ifelse(is.na(padj), "ns",
                        ifelse(padj < 0.05, formatC(padj, format = "e", digits = 1), "ns"))
  )

# --- Export the expression values behind the DESeq2-annotated boxplots ----------------
# (a) the DESeq2 model's normalized counts for these genes/samples (the "new model"
#     expression), and (b) the per-cell-line padj stats table used for the brackets.
norm_counts <- DESeq2::counts(dds_group, normalized = TRUE)[gene_ids, , drop = FALSE]
rownames(norm_counts) <- genes_boxplot
norm_long <- data.frame(gene = genes_boxplot, norm_counts, check.names = FALSE) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-gene, names_to = "sample", values_to = "norm_count") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(meta, by = "sample") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(gene, cell_line, time, sample)

readr::write_csv(norm_long,
                 file.path(PATHS$results_dir, "target_gene_expression_DESeq2_normalized_counts.csv"))
readr::write_csv(dplyr::select(stat_df, cell_line, gene, group1, group2, padj),
                 file.path(PATHS$results_dir, "target_gene_stats_DESeq2_padj.csv"))

time_colors <- c(DMSO = "#E9D8A6", "24h" = "#D9BE6D", "48h" = "#d6ac2f")

make_target_boxplot <- function(df, stats_df, cell_line_label) {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = time, y = expr)) +
    geom_boxplot(aes(fill = time), outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 1.4, colour = "grey20") +
    facet_wrap(~ gene, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1) +
    ggpubr::stat_pvalue_manual(stats_df, label = "label",
                               xmin = "group1", xmax = "group2",
                               y.position = "y.position",
                               tip.length = 0.01, size = 2.8) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = time_colors) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.18))) +
    labs(title = paste0("Target gene expression — ", cell_line_label),
         subtitle = "Batch-corrected VST (display); DESeq2 padj (Benjamini-Hochberg)",
         x = NULL, y = "Normalized expression (VST)", fill = "Time") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
}

# One figure per cell line.
for (cl in levels(factor(expr_long$cell_line))) {
  df_cl   <- dplyr::filter(expr_long, cell_line == cl)
  stat_cl <- dplyr::filter(stat_df, cell_line == cl)
  p_cl <- make_target_boxplot(df_cl, stat_cl, cl)
  print(p_cl)
  ggsave(file.path(PATHS$results_dir, paste0("target_gene_boxplots_", cl, ".pdf")),
         plot = p_cl, width = 35, height = 12, units = "cm")
}
```

```{r target_gene_boxplots_ttest}
# Simpler alternative to the DESeq2-based figure above: pairwise t-tests computed
# DIRECTLY on the batch-corrected VST values that are plotted. Less rigorous than the
# count-model stats (ignores the negative-binomial dispersion model, and n is small per
# group), but kept as a quick visual sanity check. Reuses expr_long from the chunk above.
#
# The design is PAIRED: each replicate series (batch1 / rep1 / rep2 / rep3) is one time
# course DMSO -> 24h -> 48h of the same cells, so the tests are paired t-tests on the
# within-series differences. ggpubr::stat_compare_means(paired = TRUE) would pair samples
# by row order and break on the incomplete series (CLBMa has no 48h in rep2, SK_N_SH has
# no rep3), so the tests are computed explicitly here — matching samples on the series id
# and dropping series that lack one of the two time points — and drawn with
# stat_pvalue_manual, as in the DESeq2 chunk above.

# Series ("one time course") id, same convention as the ssGSEA dynamics chunk.
expr_long <- expr_long %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    series = paste(sub("^(CM|SH)_.*", "\\1", sample),
                   ifelse(grepl("_batch1$", sample), "batch1",
                          stringr::str_extract(sample, "rep[0-9]")),
                   sep = "_")
  )

# Export the VST expression values plotted in BOTH boxplot sets (the boxes/points are the
# same batch-corrected VST values in the DESeq2 and the t-test figures).
readr::write_csv(
  expr_long %>% dplyr::arrange(gene, cell_line, time, sample),
  file.path(PATHS$results_dir, "target_gene_expression_VST.csv")
)

time_comparisons <- list(c("DMSO", "24h"), c("DMSO", "48h"), c("24h", "48h"))

# Paired t-test of one gene, one cell line, one pair of time points: the two values of a
# series are matched, series without both time points are dropped.
paired_ttest <- function(df, g1, g2) {
  wide <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(time %in% c(g1, g2)) %>%
    dplyr::select(series, time, expr) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = time, values_from = expr) %>%
    tidyr::drop_na(dplyr::all_of(c(g1, g2)))
  d <- wide[[g2]] - wide[[g1]]
  p <- if (length(d) < 2 || stats::sd(d) == 0) {
    NA_real_
  } else {
    stats::t.test(wide[[g2]], wide[[g1]], paired = TRUE)$p.value
  }
  data.frame(group1 = g1, group2 = g2, n_pairs = length(d), p = p)
}

ttest_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(levels(factor(expr_long$cell_line)), function(cl) {
  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(genes_boxplot, function(g) {
    df_g <- dplyr::filter(expr_long, cell_line == cl, gene == g)
    dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(time_comparisons, function(cmp) {
      cbind(cell_line = cl, gene = g, paired_ttest(df_g, cmp[1], cmp[2]))
    }))
  }))
}))

# Same bracket staggering / label formatting as the DESeq2 figure (y_ranges from above).
ttest_df <- ttest_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(cell_line, gene) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(rank = dplyr::row_number()) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::left_join(y_ranges, by = c("cell_line", "gene")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    y.position = ymax + step * rank,
    gene       = factor(gene, levels = genes_boxplot),
    label      = ifelse(is.na(p), "ns",
                        ifelse(p < 0.05, formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 1), "ns"))
  )

readr::write_csv(dplyr::select(ttest_df, cell_line, gene, group1, group2, n_pairs, p),
                 file.path(PATHS$results_dir, "target_gene_stats_paired_ttest_VST.csv"))

make_target_boxplot_ttest <- function(df, stats_df, cell_line_label) {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = time, y = expr)) +
    geom_boxplot(aes(fill = time), outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 1.4, colour = "grey20") +
    facet_wrap(~ gene, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1) +
    ggpubr::stat_pvalue_manual(stats_df, label = "label",
                               xmin = "group1", xmax = "group2",
                               y.position = "y.position",
                               tip.length = 0.01, size = 2.8) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = time_colors) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.18))) +
    labs(title = paste0("Target gene expression — ", cell_line_label),
         subtitle = "Batch-corrected VST; paired t-tests on VST values (paired by replicate series)",
         x = NULL, y = "Normalized expression (VST)", fill = "Time") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
}

# One figure per cell line (paired t-test version).
for (cl in levels(factor(expr_long$cell_line))) {
  df_cl   <- dplyr::filter(expr_long, cell_line == cl)
  stat_cl <- dplyr::filter(ttest_df, cell_line == cl)
  p_cl <- make_target_boxplot_ttest(df_cl, stat_cl, cl)
  print(p_cl)
  ggsave(file.path(PATHS$results_dir, paste0("target_gene_boxplots_ttest_", cl, ".pdf")),
         plot = p_cl, width = 35, height = 12, units = "cm")
}
```
